content: Rendering user-controlled chat content to HTML/Markdown is a stored-XSS and path-traversal surface. CVEs show: unescaped sender_name, message body, file.name, file.url, and media filenames all lead to script execution (open-webui GHSA-9f4f, GHSA-pwxh, GHSA-hcwp; Orbis chat-widget; Discourse CVE-2024-52794 via image filename; nanobot GHSA-3f63 path traversal via WhatsApp document fileName written with path.join and raw '..'). Prevention: HTML-escape ALL user fields (sender, body, media filename, alt text) at render time; for HTML output use a sanitizer (DOMPurify) or strict textContent/setAttribute; escape/allowlist media filenames and assert the resolved path stays inside the media dir (basename + post-join startsWith check); neutralize 'javascript:' URIs in links.
